claim.value: The selected trial must be bounded.
claim.scope: Trial chosen after translating the reduction findings; this span does not specify the bounds.

provenance.rationale: The mapping explicitly requires boundedness when selecting the trial.

signal_basis.value: With test conditions fixed, a smaller configuration repeatedly reproduces lateness while specified further removals cease to reproduce it. This evidence remains specific to the tested case and does not establish field effectiveness.
signal_basis.scope: The selected reconstructed turnaround and its replay; no established generalization to all late starts or field outcomes.

provenance.rationale: The cited spans establish the reduction signal, controlled test conditions, selected-case context, and limits on field effectiveness and generalization.
This supported procedural constraint requires no additional unresolved empirical relation.

rationale: The evidence licenses a bounded trial as a limited next step because reproduction under the selected test leaves field effectiveness and broader applicability unestablished. The claim imposes a trial-selection constraint without asserting that the trial will succeed.
uncertainty: The atomic claim does not specify particular bounds; their adequacy is outside this judgment.
